title: Carrot Raisin Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of orange juice (juice from ½ half of a large orange)
2 (10-ounce) bags shredded carrots, available from the produce department
2 tablespoons poppy seeds (available in the spice aisle)
directions: Mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for two hours.
Note: This recipe can be easily doubled or tripled. And if it seems to dry to you, feel free to add more yogurt or mayonnaise.
Mix olive oil, lime juice, sugar, salt, pepper
Pour dressing over carrots and raisins
Sometimes I add orange zest and chopped candied orange peel or a tablespoon of orange marmalade for an added twist.
There you have it: crunchy carrots, chewy sun-dried fruit, sweet, sour and delicious.

Combine all ingredients well, using your fingers to toss and coat the carrots thoroughly. Transfer to a travel container or serving dish. As the salad sits, the raisins will plump a bit and carrots will take on citrus taste.
